headline: First mechanical watch under $900: 4 picks
stop_reason: Not enough verified picks. Verified on official pages (checked 21 Nov 2026): Hamilton Khaki Field Mechanical H69439931, $675 USD, hand-wound (hamiltonwatch.com/en-us/h69439931); Seiko Prospex SRPL15 $575 and SRPL13 $595 USD (seikowatches.com/us-en/products/prospex/lineup). Seiko's official pages do not state the movement, so 'mechanical' for the two Seiko picks is still unconfirmed by the manufacturer, and the Seiko product page URL from the library returned 404. No fourth verified pick. Needs an owner or approver decision: confirm Seiko movement on a manufacturer page, or add a fourth verified pick.
